items.text: The wait is over—Patch 1.6 and Truck Skin Pack 2 are live! 🚛
First, thank you for your passion and patience. This update is a major milestone for Alaskan Road Truckers, and we’re excited to share what’s new and improved.

We’re thrilled to continue this journey with our incredible community. Your feedback drives our improvements, and your support motivates us to keep trucking forward.

releases.displayName: Developer Dispatch: What to Expect in Our Next Alaskan Road Truckers Update!

items.text: Hi everyone!

I know we haven't talked for a long time, but we had reasons. Do you know those stories about people who "lock themselves in the garage" and work on something until they finish it? That's us. For the past two months, we've been updating Alaskan Road Truckers to address the community feedback.

First up was AI, which has become faster, smoother, and more natural. Cars will overtake you if you drive too slowly and honk their horn if you create a traffic jam, bringing our world to life. We've improved the foliage, which now transitions much more smoothly between different levels of detail as it approaches the screen. We've increased the draw distance of distant lands - although here we haven't yet reached the target effect, the work continues and you'll see more improvements in the next patch. It’s a matter of balancing between the visuals and memory usage.

We fixed more than a hundred bugs reported by you. We removed - hopefully finally - problems like the truck shooting into space or getting stuck on the base computer screen. If there are more, keep reporting them. We’re reading your posts, we’re here, and we’ve just been heads down while working to make this the very best experience for you all.

Optimization took place in several stages and was carried out by several "teams." First, a lot of time was spent on profiling, i.e. identifying what didn't work best and what could be improved. To do this, we consulted with the best from our gamedev backyard. We still need to finish the work in this area as well, but you will probably already notice that the game runs much smoother.

On top of that, we've made quite a few quality-of-life improvements. You can now change the steering wheel turning speed on the controller or keyboard. We've changed the options screen so that more attention is drawn to the options most requested. We introduced a new preset for the controller, going toward more "console" solutions. All of the above, by the way, was another part of our ongoing work on the console version, which we will be able to talk about soon, but everything is on track and looking promising.

At the same time, we continue to work on improving the PC version. We hope this will be reflected in your feedback. Our goal is to make ART a game worth sinking into. Are we moving in the right direction? You tell us!
We wish you a great Alaskan experience.
Michal from Road Studio

Hello truckers!

We've just launched a brand new update for Alaskan Road Truckers. One of the key pieces of feedback has been about customizing your trucker journey, being able to choose a little more and play the game your way.
This update aims to address that. That's why we're inviting you to...

The Trucking Legends Update will give you three options to choose from when you start a new game. In addition to the standard balanced normal mode, you'll also have Casual and Legend options to choose from.

In Casual mode you'll experience an easier time when delivering, perfect if you just want to sit back and get on with trucking. Resources will deplete less fast, the weather will be less punishing - overall it'll be a kinder expeirence.

If you want to test your skills, however, you can choose the new Legend mode. Here you'll start in the depths of winter. Weather will be harder to deal with, missions will be tougher. The game will be much harder to play, and you'll have to fight for survival to become a true Trucking Legend.
New game modes! (We may add more in the future)
Casual
Better weather, more time for delivery and slower consumption of resources. You start in the summer.
Standard
This is the intended, balanced experience.
Legend
Difficult weather conditions and more demanding orders. You start in winter, with a jacket and wheel chains in your truck's equipment.
New Legend truck skin, available in customization workshops.
DLSS will now save properly after you set it and won't reset every time you launch the game. However, upon the introduction of the update, you will need to set your DLSS one final time.
Mechanics related to time flow are now fixed, parts or resources do not deplete when leaving the game on idle, sleeping, or being transported to the Hospital.
New controller scheme that can be selected in the Settings, offering a similar experience to other games in the genre.

releases.displayName: Supporting Alaskan Road Truckers - The Patch Plan

items.text: Hello truckers!

We’ve had a busy time since the launch of Alaskan Road Truckers. With nine patches for our game since launch (and more incoming!) we thought it’d be a great time to talk to you all about what our plans are for Alaskan Road Truckers and how we’ll be supporting the game into the future.

We want to make the best trucker game ever made, where you live, breathe, and survive as a trucker in one of the most punishing environments on the planet. That’s been our goal since day one and it still is today.

It’s fair to say that we haven’t hit that goal yet. Alaskan Road Truckers is a game we’re incredibly proud of, but we know it still needs work. Technical issues, bugs, and quality of life issues have overshadowed the wonderful experience we’ve put in the core of Alaskan Road Truckers, and we recognize that this has caused disappointment for some.

We want you to know that we hear you. We know that for some players the issues affecting Alaskan Road Truckers has meant they have been unable to enjoy the game, and this is why we have been introducing rapid fixes to help those players get in the game and start trucking. Every patch has improved the game, with the core experience now being more accessible, key bugs are fixed, and for most the game should be more playable.
Of course, we have lots of work still to do, and there are key areas we will be focusing on as we continue to support Alaskan Road Truckers through the rest of 2023 - and beyond.

As mentioned above, we have been working on rapid patches for the most pressing issues. Now, we’re moving into a separate phase of our support plan, where we’ll be reducing the amount of patches we release and focusing on larger updates which will resolve more issues, to provide a more stable Alaskan Road Truckers experience. The issues we’re working on are bigger issues, ones that will take more time to resolve, and for a small team this means we’ll have to slow down a little bit to make sure we get these patches done right.

notes.title: The areas we’re focusing on at the moment are

items.text: AI Tweaks and Improvements
Optimization and Performance Enhancements
Controller / Steering Wheel Improvements

These are large things for us to tackle but we are making a commitment to get these issues ironed out and make sure that Alaskan Road Truckers is brought up to a technical level we are happy with. We cannot say that these will be fixed in one patch, or even two, but incremental improvements will be made and we are putting our focus on resolving these key areas sooner rather than later.

This, of course, doesn’t mean we are neglecting other bug reports and issues reported to us. As we continue to update and patch our game, we’ll be fixing other issues alongside working on the bigger things, you’ll be able to see what we’re fixing in each set of patch notes.

In addition to the above, we are working to get the console version of the game for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S complete and ready for release as soon as possible. We will have news to share about this very soon.

We will also be adhering to our content roadmap. So while we will be working on these issues, we will also be producing content and updates that will expand and deepen the core Alaskan Road Truckers experience. Look out for more news on these updates soon!
One of the points we’ve made continuously throughout development of Alaskan Road Truckers is that we haven’t made this game alone. Now the game is out in the world; this is still true.

Your bug reports, issue reports, reviews, and technical reports have helped us to laser focus our work on the things that really matter to the people who matter - you. That’s why we’re asking for your help again, this time in helping us test upcoming updates.

If you’re interested in helping us test updates, please head over to our Discord server where you can find details of how to opt in to the beta branch of the game as well as where you can post any issues you encounter. We made the decision to run this initiative using our Discord server as a central hub as it allows us to monitor + track issues, and respond to feedback in real-time, helping us to better work on any issues that may crop up.
Thank you to everyone who takes part in this - we do test our own patches, but we are a small team so more hands on the testing wheel means more stable patches.
We’ve got a long road ahead of us and we hope you’ll continue to join us on it. See you out there, truckers!

items.text: Hi, Truckers!
First and foremost, we want to address the buzz around our game's name change. We love to see your warm comments about the new name and direction in which we are heading with the game.

We've decided to rebrand as Alaskan Road Truckers to better reflect the unique essence of the game. We believe this new name truly encapsulates the core experience we're striving to deliver. In Alaskan Road Truckers, you're not just a truck; you're a dedicated trucker, and you’ll be getting in and out of your truck, hitching uploads, fueling up your truck, and maintaining the health of your driver in the Alaskan outdoors.

Rest assured, this name change does not alter our commitment to creating the definitive Alaskan trucking experience. We're still working tirelessly to provide you with expansive vistas, teeming with life, variety, and treacherous conditions that will put your skills to the test. Our team is committed to providing a comprehensive simulation that offers a genuine trucker experience, a lifelike driving model, and a fully immersive career mode. In essence, everything we were working on before, but now with a name that truly aligns with our ambitions.

With the new name and key art we’ve also decided to update screenshots for the game on Steam to better showcase the direction in which the reworked graphic design is heading! If you liked what you saw and you are interested in having them as wallpaper on your PC, we’ve prepared a special folder with all of them - feel free to use them! 👇
